sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [Bb]Sowing in the morning, sowing seeds of [Eb]kindness,
[Bb]Sowing in the noontide [F]and the dewy eve,
[Bb]Waiting for the harvest and the [Bb7]time of [Eb]reaping –
[Bb]We shall come rejoicing, [F7]bringing in the [Bb]sheaves.
[Bb]Bringing in the sheaves, [Eb]bringing in the [Bb]sheaves,
[Bb]We shall come rejoicing, bringing [C7]in the [F]sheaves.
[Bb]Bringing in the sheaves, [Eb]bringing in the [Bb]sheaves,
[Bb]We shall come rejoicing, [F7]bringing in the [Bb]sheaves.

sections.name: Refrain
lines: [Bb]Bringing in the sheaves, [Eb]bringing in the sheaves,
[Bb]We shall come rejoicing, [F]bringing in the sheaves.
[Bb]Bringing in [Bb7]the sheaves, bringing [Eb]in the sheaves,
[Bb]We shall [F7]come rejoicing, bringing [Bb]in the sheaves.

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [Bb]Sowing in the sunshine, [Eb]sowing in the shadows,
[Bb]Fearing neither clouds [F]nor winter's chilling breeze;
[Bb]By and by [Bb7]the harvest and [Eb]the labor ended -
[Bb]We shall [F7]come rejoicing, bringin [Bb]in the sheaves.

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [Bb]Going forth with weeping, [Eb]sowing for the Master,
[Bb]Tho the loss sustained [F]our spirit often grieves;
[Bb]When our weeping's [Bb7]over He will [Eb]bid us welcome -
[Bb]We shall [F7]come rejoicing, bringing [Bb]in the sheaves
